奖励模式是人类偏好与RL训练信号之间的桥梁。 训练有素的奖励模式对成功的RLHF至关重要;训练有素的奖励模式会导致对黑客和错位行为的奖励。本节涵盖理论基础，实用培训技术和Reward Model的建筑选择。
blocks.originalExcerpt: Reward models are the bridge between human preferences and the RL training signal. A well-trained reward model is essential for successful RLHF; a poorly trained one leads to reward hacking and misaligned behaviour. This section covers the theoretical foundations, practical training techniques, and architectural choices for reward models.

blocks.originalExcerpt: Raw reward model outputs can have arbitrary scale and offset. Centering the rewards (subtracting the mean) stabilises RL training:

blocks.originalExcerpt: Length Bias Correction Reward models are known to exhibit length bias: they tend to assign higher rewards to longer responses, regardless of quality. This can be corrected by:

blocks.originalExcerpt: 1. Length normalisation: divide the reward by the response length.

blocks.text: 2. 长度控制培训:将长度列为一项特征，并培训该模式为长度。

blocks.originalExcerpt: 3. Calibration: post-hoc regression to remove the length effect.

从可验证奖励(RLVR)中强化学习，使用定型的，基于规则的奖励功能，而不是学习的奖励模式。这大大减少了reward hacking(虽然模型仍然可以利用格式诡计、边缘案例或测试记忆)，也是DeepSeek-R1[72]中使用的方法。
blocks.originalExcerpt: Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) uses deterministic, rule-based reward functions instead of learned reward models. This substantially reduces reward hacking (though models can still exploit format tricks, edge cases, or test memorization) and is the approach used in DeepSeek-R1 [72]. blocks.text: 规则奖励陷阱
blocks.originalExcerpt: Rule-Based Reward Pitfalls

blocks.text: · 格式游戏:模型学习生成正确格式而不正确内容。
blocks.originalExcerpt: • Format gaming: models learn to produce the correct format without correct content.

blocks.text: 始终将格式与正确性奖励结合起来。
blocks.originalExcerpt: Always combine format and correctness rewards.

blocks.text: • 试验个案漏泄:如果试验个案在训练数据中，模型会记起这些个案。
blocks.originalExcerpt: • Test case leakage: if test cases are in the training data, the model memorises them.

blocks.text: • 超时开发:模型可能生成时断时断的代码(避免失败)。
blocks.originalExcerpt: • Timeout exploitation: models may generate code that times out (avoiding failure). Use

blocks.text: 严格暂停，并明确惩罚暂停。
blocks.originalExcerpt: strict timeouts and penalise timeouts explicitly.

blocks.text: • 奖励垃圾:二进制奖励(0/1)可能太少，无法完成复杂的任务。
blocks.originalExcerpt: • Reward sparsity: binary rewards (0/1) can be too sparse for complex tasks. Consider

blocks.text: 部分信贷或中等报酬。
blocks.originalExcerpt: partial credit or intermediate rewards.

blocks.originalExcerpt: 2. Normalise then sum (GDPO): normalise each reward to zero mean and unit variance

blocks.originalExcerpt: 3. Lexicographic: optimise rewards in priority order; only consider lower-priority rewards
